describe: The image shows a grimy plaster or stone wall with patchy dark brown-black stains at the top, fading into warm orange-brown and rust streaks. Pale grey-white worn plaster patches and chipped areas are visible in the lower middle and lower left, with a dark band along the bottom. Colours are dark umber, rust orange, cream and grey, with moderate-to-high contrast and uneven lighting. The wall has no regular pattern.
